entries.text: A pull request title or body edit no longer holds five runners while it waits for the full CI run. The `CI (text edit)` check makes one decision and fails at once when the full run on the commit is missing or still running; the new `ci-text-edit-refresh` workflow re-runs the failed jobs of the newest `CI (text edit)` run on that commit when the full CI run completes. The `oracle-gate` workflow now shares one concurrency group per pull request head commit for runs started by `pull_request` or `pull_request_target` workflows, so superseded gate runs are cancelled.
